title: fix(app-shell): the datasource delete confirm and its refusal name the objects that still use it, in the console's language

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuQqREozq6kAm9qNDvozztaj)_

Refs #30335

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：设置 → 数据源，删除确认框会列出仍在使用该数据源的对象，并说明在它们还在时删不掉；服务端拒绝删除后，提示改用控制台语言，点名这些对象并说明下一步（删除对象或改到其他数据源）。
- 为什么改：服务端拒绝时只回一句英文和一个数量，页面原样塞进中文外框（「删除 parts_db 失败：Cannot remove datasource …」），中文管理员看不懂，也不知道是哪些对象挡住了。
- 风险与回滚：只改前端一个页面和 studio 词条（新增 3 行 en/zh）；对象读取失败或非 400 失败时保持原样显示服务端原文；回滚即还原本 PR，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/datasource/DatasourceResourcePage.tsx`（`openDeleteConfirm`、`remove` 的 400 分支）、`DatasourceResourcePage.deleteConfirm-13333.test.tsx` 第二个 describe、`ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/zh.ts` 的 `engine.datasource.deleteBound*`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/datasource/DatasourceResourcePage.deleteConfirm-13333.test.tsx`，预期 8 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Card #30335, the **datasource half only**. The storage half (`SettingsView.tsx`, console locales) stays on the card, serial behind #30329, so this PR does not close it.

- **The confirm.** Opening a datasource's delete reads object metadata (`MetadataClient.list('object')`) and keeps each object whose `datasource` names the row, the same test the server's delete guard counts by. While any is listed, the dialog body says the datasource cannot be deleted yet and asks to delete each object or move it to another datasource first, and the objects are listed by label with the name beside it. With none, or when the read fails, the dialog is unchanged. The delete button stays enabled: the server is still the judge.
- **The refusal.** `api()` now keeps the HTTP status and the envelope's `error.code` on the thrown error. A `400` from `DELETE /api/v1/datasources/:name` re-reads the bound objects; when any remain, the toast is `engine.datasource.deleteBoundRefused`, naming the datasource, the objects (joined with the locale's separator row) and the next step. Every other failure, and a `400` with no bound object, keeps the server's message in the existing `engine.datasource.deleteFailed` frame. No server text is matched.
- **i18n (the widening).** Three new `studio` namespace rows, en and zh: `engine.datasource.deleteBoundBody`, `engine.datasource.deleteBoundRefused`, `engine.datasource.boundObjectSeparator` (a punctuation row, since the package's `lib` is ES2020 and has no `Intl.ListFormat`).
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/30335-datasource-delete-names-bound-objects.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` patch.

Branch: the harness-assigned `claude/project-thread-x1xjpw`, not `claude/issue-30335-*`; the card is #30335.

## Tests

`DatasourceResourcePage.deleteConfirm-13333.test.tsx` gains a second top-level describe (5 cases) on the existing harness; expectations are read from Studio's table, never retyped:

- guard: the two new zh rows are real zh rows;
- the confirm lists the three objects bound to `parts_db` (label with name, name alone when unlabelled) and not the one on `default`, with the bound body instead of the plain one;
- a `400` refusal is reported in zh, naming the objects, and the server's English never reaches the toast;
- CONTROL: no bound object keeps the plain body, and a `400` keeps the server's message;
- CONTROL: a `503` keeps the server's message even while objects are bound.

The three existing cases run unchanged (their fake metadata client has no `list`, which exercises the failed-read path).

## Acceptance notes

- Row Test failure toast (the `test` handler's `${name}: ${message}`) is untouched: it does not fall out of this change.
- Server half, out of scope here (`packages/**` is the server lane): the refusal is a plain `Error` answered `400 DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR` with a count and no object names or `details`, so a client that does not read object metadata cannot name them. Reported to the seat to file.
- The confirm's list is a metadata read at open time; the server's count is taken at delete time from the same object listing. They can differ only if an object is saved in between, and then the server still refuses and the toast re-reads.

## Verification

Gates and tests ran on `de1864eb`; the head adds an evidence commit and its removal, the tree is byte-identical (`git diff de1864eb HEAD` is empty). Base `fdd06415`.

<details><summary>Live rig and screenshots (zh-CN, 1440 wide)</summary>

`examples/app-showcase` `objectstack dev --seed-admin` on a private port, the console via `vite` in `ui/apps/console` with `DEV_PROXY_TARGET`, Chromium, browser locale zh-CN. A runtime sqlite datasource `parts_db` (label 零件库) with two objects saved through `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/:name` naming it (零件 `parts_part`, 供应商 `parts_supplier`).

`DELETE /api/v1/datasources/parts_db` answered `HTTP 400` with `{"success":false,"error":{"code":"DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR","message":"Cannot remove datasource 'parts_db': 2 object(s) are still bound to it."}}`, and `GET /api/v1/meta/object` served both objects with `datasource: parts_db`.

Before (page restored to the base for the shot): confirm `连接 parts_db 将被移除。此操作不可撤销。`; toast `删除 parts_db 失败：Cannot remove datasource 'parts_db': 2 object(s) are still bound to it.`

![before confirm](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/e3cffec4e8337f6d5e3975fca00b0e7d1c2b2b5f/evidence/30335/before-1-confirm-zh-1440.png?raw=true)
![before toast](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/e3cffec4e8337f6d5e3975fca00b0e7d1c2b2b5f/evidence/30335/before-2-refused-toast-zh-1440.png?raw=true)

After: confirm `以下对象仍在使用 parts_db，暂时无法删除。请先删除这些对象，或把它们改到其他数据源：` with `零件 (parts_part)`, `供应商 (parts_supplier)`; toast `未删除 parts_db：零件 (parts_part)、供应商 (parts_supplier) 仍在使用它。请先删除这些对象或把它们改到其他数据源，再删除 parts_db。`

![after confirm](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/e3cffec4e8337f6d5e3975fca00b0e7d1c2b2b5f/evidence/30335/after-1-confirm-zh-1440.png?raw=true)
